integrity: Proof supported by exact Laurent-polynomial rank and determinant certificates, uniform local-incidence argument, and standalone executable checks. Indexed closest nonequivariant note available only in summary; priority not definitive. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology for the natural dihedral action and ordinary quotient spaces, restricted to the open neighborhood complexes of third-power cycles of length at least thirteen. Does not assert integral homology, equivariant Borel homology, or quotient homotopy types.
title: Dihedral rational homology of third-power cycle neighborhood complexes
